Thanks. That

I can explain the documented workflow, but I do not have approved information confirming whether your specific tool is supported.

Let me check the owner-approved knowledge for AIowa Agents services relevant to handling quote requests.

AIowa Agents builds AI agents for small businesses that handle inbox triage and follow-ups. The agent works inside tools you already use, and you choose the approval level—so it can draft responses for your team to review before anything goes out.

It can also chase unanswered requests with timed nudges, again based on your approval settings.

I can’t confirm Outlook or Excel support specifically, and I don’t have approved pricing or timing information to share. Would you like me to prepare a short human-review note with what you’ve shared so far?

Nothing should be sent.
